name: Turtle Dex
rootCause: According to BSC news, Turtle.dex has run away, taking away about 9,000 BNB, worth more than 2 million U.S. dollars, and the website and telegram group have been deleted. BSC news refers to this as a well-thought-out and planned running behavior. At present, part of the funds have been converted into ETH to enter the Binance Exchange, and investors are urging Binance to freeze related accounts. On March 15th, in response to the question of whether it would run away, Turtle officially stated: No, because the turtles have short hands. Note: Turtle means sea turtle.

descriptions.text: According to BSC news, Turtle.dex has run away, taking away about 9,000 BNB, worth more than 2 million U.S. dollars, and the website and telegram group have been deleted. BSC news refers to this as a well-thought-out and planned running behavior. At present, part of the funds have been converted into ETH to enter the Binance Exchange, and investors are urging Binance to freeze related accounts. On March 15th, in response to the question of whether it would run away, Turtle officially stated: No, because the turtles have short hands. Note: Turtle means sea turtle.

TurtleDex, a BSC-based decentralized storage project, conducted a rug pull in March 2021. The team drained about $2.4 million in BNB from liquidity pools on ApeSwap and PancakeSwap, swapped assets, deleted online presence, and no recovery has been reported. The project team retained privileged control over pooled assets and liquidity, enabling unilateral withdrawal of all BNB and TTDX tokens from decentralized exchange pools. No contract-level restriction, ownership renouncement, or governance prevented this.
